messages:
alice_devex: Quick check — SDK + quickstarts targeted for Friday cut. Are we still on for changelog cutoff EOD Thursday? Need owners for the sample-apps deploys and final doc review.

ben_platform: I'm good on infra side. I can own sample-apps infra deploy (k8s manifests + cloudbuild). Will need the final image tags by 11am Thu to validate canary. :+1:

carla_docs: Docs team is blocked on two outstanding snippets from SDK team — async streaming and error handling. @elaine_sdk can you drop the snippets by Wed EOD? We also need a short migration note for v2->v3 client changes.

elaine_sdk: Yep, I'll push streaming snippet PR tonight. Migration note draft by Wed morning. Will ping for a quick review.

dmitri_release: Changelog cutoff plan: freeze external-facing change entries at 2026-03-19T23:59 UTC. Internal/infra notes can land until Friday noon. For release packaging I'll need the final package.json / pyproject version bumped before CI cut (Thu 11:30 UTC).

frank_eng_runtime: Heads-up — eng-runtime may have a small hotfix that touches the batching config flags. If that lands Thursday morning, we'll need to decide whether to include in this release or ship as patch after. Suggest we triage Thu 09:00 UTC.

alice_devex: OK scheduling note: triage Thu 09:00 UTC (15m) — decide hotfix include/risk. If not included we proceed with final cut.

release-bot: reminder: @dmitri_release set release branch r/devex-v3-2026-03-20 at 1781705600. CI: https://ci.redwood/internal/1234 — all checks passing: 8/8

ben_platform: For sample-apps images: use tags like devex-sample:v3-1781704321. I'll run canary against staging cluster once images available. Please push images to our registry: registry.redwood/devex-sample.

elaine_sdk: Bumping npm & pip packages tonight. Quick commands:

```
# JS
npm version minor -m "chore(release): v%s"
npm publish --access public

# Python
poetry version minor
poetry publish -r pypi
```

carla_docs: Changelog PR template reminder (put these in the PR body):
- summary (1-2 lines)
- entry type: fix/feature/dep/docs
- migration impact: none/minor/major
- owner: @handle

frank_eng_runtime: @alice_devex can you confirm whether we should enable the new batching flag by default? If enabled it may reduce cost but adds risk to latency spike for short seqs.

alice_devex: Let's default to OFF. We can enable in Dedicated only for canary customers first. Add onboarding note in quickstart.

dmitri_release: Owners assigned: infra deploy -> @ben_platform; docs final -> @carla_docs; SDK release -> @elaine_sdk; release manager -> @dmitri_release. If anyone can't meet these deadlines reply now.

elaine_sdk: I have one more ask: can someone run a smoke of the node quickstart sample against staging after I publish? @ben_platform?

ben_platform: Yep I can do the smoke test Thu 12:00 UTC. Please @me when image & packages live.

carla_docs: After SDK PRs land I'll update quickstart steps and add a short troubleshooting section for the new auth header flow.

alice_devex: Final checklist for slice: (short)
- [ ] Changelog entries merged by Thu EOD (owners: all)
- [ ] SDK packages published (owner: elaine_sdk)
- [ ] Sample-app images pushed (owner: ben_platform)
- [ ] Docs quickstart updated + migration note (owner: carla_docs)
- [ ] Release branch created and CI green (owner: dmitri_release)

release-bot: note: changelog cutoff set to 1781708399. Any PRs merged after that timestamp must include label `post-release`.

alice_devex: Thanks all — I'll post a short status thread Thu 12:30 UTC with blockers. If anything urgent ping here or DM. :shipit:
